title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-01-03
lineage: Master DAT > Panasonic SV-3700 > UA-5 > USB > WaveLab  Mastering in WaveLab with iZotope Ozone 4 > CD Wave > TLH > Flac

ai_review.summary: Solid recording (likely soundboard) of an early‑1970 show that shines on Cosmic Charlie, Mason’s Children and a beautiful Wolf.
ai_review.review: The three reviewers all rate the set highly, calling it an excellent early‑'70 performance with standout renditions of Workingman's material, Cosmic Charlie, Mason’s Children and a gorgeous “Wolf” jam. Recording quality is described as solid with only minor cuts, making the music easy to enjoy despite the lack of detailed source information.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are 4‑5 stars and praise the musical performance; recording is noted as solid with only minor issues, yielding a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers mention an overall solid quality with small cuts but no major problems; no explicit comment on soundboard vs. audience.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as solid and enjoyable, with early‑'70 energy; no specific criticism of pacing or flow.
